category_edits.rationale: For all four category models, concentrate causal pooling on immediate interests by shortening its decay scale from 4 to 2, retaining the 0.75 state / 0.25 pooled readout and padding-aware normalization. The generated predictor imports HSTURec from train.py, so inference uses the same change with unchanged checkpoint shapes and final-real-position readout. Preserve truncation, positions, features, embeddings, backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer.

change_summary: Shorten causal recency-pooling decay from 4 to 2 across all four independently trained HSTU category models, consistently in training and generated inference.
